description: How many sat and passed this Japanese national exam, and what pass rate did MHLW publish? Give exam (exam_id like nurse or physician, or the name in Japanese or English) and optionally session (dai N kai). Returns applicants, examinees, passers and pass rate as published for all candidates and new graduates, a consistency check, revisions, source URL, retrieved_at and page SHA-256. Status found, not_found_in_checked_records or unknown. Check the official page.

exam.description: exam_id (e.g. nurse, physician, pharmacist) or exam name in Japanese (看護師国家試験, 看護師) or English

session.description: Optional session number (dai N kai), 1-999, e.g. 115 for the 115th nurse exam; omit for every session this service has read

name: exam_results_lookup

candidates.description: Partial-name candidates when no exam has exactly this name or id. Not matches.

official_check.description: Read first: counts as published by MHLW at retrieved_at; check the official announcement page.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

rate_matches_counts.description: true when passers / examinees rounds to the published pass rate at its published decimals; false when not; null when not computable.

current.description: true when this result comes from the page linked from the current list.

rate_matches_counts.description: true when passers / examinees rounds to the published pass rate at its published decimals; false when not; null when not computable.

session.description: Session number (dai N kai) as on the announcement page.

retrieved_at.description: When this service last read the announcement page successfully.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: MHLW's pass announcement list page and when this service last read it.

index_retrieved_at.description: When this service last read MHLW's pass announcement list page successfully.

status.description: found = counts read from the exam's announcement page; not_found_in_checked_records = not on MHLW's current list page, or the session was not read; unknown = list not loaded or stale, page not read yet, unreadable or not fetched, or only partial-name candidates (unknown_reason).

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Japanese national exam pass results (MHLW)
